title: Maze Rats Table File
description: Schema for Maze Rats procedural table JSON files. Each file groups related tables from one section of the source booklet.

attribution.example: Maze Rats, copyright Ben Milton (questingblog.com). Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

usage_note.description: File-level note on the roll convention (2d6 group-of-6 for 36-entry tables).

roll.description: Die/mechanic used to roll this table, e.g. '2d6 (group of 6 / item in group)', '1d6', '1d12'

usage_note.description: Optional note on how or when to use this table

count_note.description: Optional note when the source's entry count differs from the expected 36 (34/35/37/38); states the discrepancy rather than silently padding or trimming

entries.description: Either a flat array of result strings (most tables), or an array of objects for tables with explicit numeric ranges or combinator logic
